description: Checks one domain name with the domain registry and returns whether it is available and what it costs. One name per call. A name without an ending, such as mybakery, is checked as .com, .nl and .app in that call. Read-only. Does not register, reserve or charge. A registered name is returned as Unavailable, or as For sale by another party when a marketplace lists it. A registry premium name is returned as premium, separate from a marketplace listing. A single-name result can include a trademark note, which is not legal advice. Works without an account. When the exact name is taken, offer the human the free variant names.

name.description: A full domain such as "myidea.com", or a bare name such as "mybakery" (checked as .com, .nl and .app).
